en: Pingyan~ Hurry up! We must reach Mengxiang by sundown!
Pa, look at me. Just look! I'm tired AND starving. Let's find somewhere to rest. I can't walk another step!
What a frail little princeling you are! The same heroic blood flows in your veins as in mine, the blood of King Wu of Zhou! How can you act so feeble? Disgraceful! I've failed our Ji ancestors!
Here we go again... What century do you think this is? Quit dragging up stuff from thousands of years ago! If our ancestors were really watching over us, we wouldn't be this dirt poor, right, Pa?
Since when do we live in misery? I raised you nice and plump, didn't I? What's there to whine about? Ungrateful little brat... Growl~ growl~
What was that? What's that noise? Come on, Pa, quit toughing it out. If you're hungry, just say so. No need to be shy.
Y-you, shut it! Let's go! We'll find a restaurant...
Yes, Pa. Whatever you say.
Uh, P-Pa... A restaurant this fancy? I don't want to spend my life washing dishes to pay for one meal!
Relax and go on in. Eat all you want!
D-did you win the lottery or something?
Do you think your old man has that kind of overnight luck?
No way! Even if you burned all your luck for your next life, you'd win 200 bucks, tops!
You ungrateful son~ Do you think so little of your own father?
I don't think little of you. I just know you too well.
Forget it! You've trained under me this long and can't sense the demonic aura here?
Now that you mention it, yeah, I can feel it. But what's that got to do with paying for dinner?
Sigh~ I'm starting to doubt you're really my son. Use that rusty tofu brain of yours! If we wipe out the demon here, then the meal...
Oh, right! Then not only won't they charge us, they might hand us a fat reward too!
See? I told you so! Let's ask around for information. Know your enemy and you'll win every battle.
Right, let's go.
Dunno why, but lately I keep seeing things on night shift.
Yeah, yeah. Especially around midnight, there are weird noises from room 204.
It's terrifying!
I-I saw it, I really saw it... It was horrible!
What did you see?
A giant spider! I saw one on the second floor on my shift last night...
A giant spider, huh...
If the economy weren't so bad, I'd have quit already.
I think this hotel's luck is about to run out.
That's three missing children in a row now.
The Longlai Hotel's a century old, but lately lots of folks have had weird encounters.
Find my child, now!
Please calm down. You'll disturb the other guests.
Calm down? How are we supposed to calm down?!
Maybe the little one wandered off to play and lost track of time?
Impossible! A six-month-old baby opened the door and went out to play? I don't care. My child vanished here, so you're responsible for finding my baby!
Even if you say so, we don't know what to do either.
My baby was gone when I woke up. Who else would I go to?
Leave this matter to us, father and son.
That's right!
Wh-who are you two?
I head the Songmen Altar. Him? Not worth the space to introduce!
Hey, enough! Don't underestimate me!
I've never expected anything from you anyway! Ha ha ha~
Wh-why you...! Want to fight?
Bring it! You think I'm scared?
..........Um, you two?
Sorry, we got carried away. Back to business. Since you're the manager, surely you know what's going on in room 204?
I can't promise to get the children back, but I can take care of that thing for you...
R-really?
But I have one condition!
Name it! Name it!
Bring this gentleman every one of your house specialties!
No problem! Absolutely no problem!
Ha ha ha~ Pingyan, didn't I tell you? Just leave it to me.
You were right... so right... This is delicious!
Ha ha ha~ All right, it's almost midnight. Gear up, we're heading to room 204.
Yeah, let's go!
It's all up to you now!
Phew~ Pingyan, the demonic aura in this room is really thick.
I know! One look at this place and any normal person would know it's haunted, or that a serial killer lives here.
Cut the wisecracks! This is serious business. One slip and you're dead. Let's search the room first and look for any clues...
Let's do it!
Pa! Look over here! This could be the giant spider's lair!
Right! Let's go in!
Whoa~ Th-this is a whole other world! If the hotel guests ever saw this place, they'd never stay here again as long as they live!
This looks nasty. After we're done, we'd better squeeze that manager for extra!
Stop! Let that child go! No more slaughter!
H-humans? How did you get in here? Where are my children?
You mean those little spiders? Don't worry! You'll be with your kids soon. Not here, of course... but in the underworld!
Wh-why you... You killed my darling children... I won't forgive you! Wretched Taoist! Prepare to die~
Curse you~ I may die... but I won't let you leave here alive...
Pingyan~ This place is collapsing! Get out of here!
N-no! You go first! I have to go back and save that kid...
No~ There's no time... If we turn back now, we'll both be buried alive!
I don't care! I can't just let them die. Forget me, go on ahead!
Th-that was way too close! I almost died in there.
..........You little brat, you scared me half to death. But I'm so glad you made it back safe. Huh? Why'd you come out alone? Where's the child?
Turns out the kid was the spider's spawn. It tried to kill me, so I got mad and...
I see! Don't dwell on it. We should get going.
Oh yeah! Did the guests and staff all get out?

No idea. Life and death are up to fate. Those meant to live will escape. Those who didn't, well, their earthly ties are done and they'll train on in another dimension! No need to worry. Let's go, Pingyan!
Okay!
Ah!
Wh-what's wrong?
Everyone's gone! Who do I bill now? Did we just work for free?
Never mind! Today's main course is only just beginning! Let's go, son!
...Okay!
Welcome to Mengxiang!
That's the famous Mengxiang Salon over there.
Dad says I can only go in when I'm grown up!
Cough cough... If only I were ten years younger... Cough cough...
Mengxiang's been uneasy lately. They say there are demons about. What century is this? Demons?
Where have all the good men in the world gone?
Why can't two beautiful sisters like us find husbands?
Hmph! Where'd that old geezer run off to now?
Phew~ This is it. This is where we were headed!
The demonic aura really is off the charts!
What's the matter, Pingyan~? Scared?
Wh-who says I'm scared?! Let's go! You think I'm afraid?
Then in we go.
Boss Wang~ Don't rush off~ Stay a little longer with me~
D-don't try to talk me out of it! I'm leaving! It's terrifying! Know what I just saw? A fox floating in midair, glaring at me with huge eyes!
Mmm~ Pretty please~ Boss Wang~ don't go~
No! No! Partying is fun and all, but my life comes first! ...Don't say another word, I'm leaving...
Boss Wang...
Excuse me...
Care for some fun, sir~? Come in, come in...
We've been hired by Manager Li to exorcise the demon here.

Bah! Not customers! Come this way. Things have been really spooky lately! We only just opened, but customers come once and never dare come back! Lots of them say a fox spirit pops out to scare them. None of us have ever seen it, though!
Relax! Leave this place to us!
Too scary! I'm never coming back.
Th-this creepy place... I'm never coming here again!
G-good heavens! It's broad daylight... and I just saw the fox spirit causing trouble!
Now it's acting up in broad daylight. Wh-what do we do? I think I should quit!
Be careful! Something big is going to happen to you soon~
Really? Can you tell me what?
Heaven's secrets must not be revealed. Young man! Experience it firsthand!
Please hurry and drive the demon out, or we'll all lose our jobs.
Xiaoyu's been acting kind of strange.
Masters~ You've finally come! I've been waiting ages. Do you sense anything?
This place reeks of demonic aura. If we don't act fast, it could get irreversible~
Then it's all in your hands, Masters!
Don't worry! We're experts. Leave this sort of thing to us!
Xiaoyu! It's me~ It's me, Shaobai!
I won't let you leave me... Xiaoyu, you are mine...
You demon fox! Let her go! Or you'll throw away a hundred years of training...

What would a stinking Taoist know? Xiaoyu was my wife in a past life! I waited thousands of years for her! I finally broke that wretched seal and found Xiaoyu reborn. What's wrong with coming back for her?

If your bond was from a past life, then your earthly ties are spent. You're different beings now. She's been reborn human, and Heaven has given her a new path so she can experience this world. Why cling so hard?
I don't care! I'll be with Xiaoyu forever!
Then you'll have to get past me first...
C-curses~
Go! I won't kill you! Those wounds will take you a good hundred years to heal, I'd say!
X-Xiaoyu~ Sob~ Even if I must wait a hundred more years, I'll be back for you...
..........Pingyan, do you think we did the right thing?
I don't know... I don't want to think about it anymore. Let's go.
You were amazing just now! Here's your well-earned reward. Thank you!
Let's skip the reward. I didn't resolve things perfectly, so I can't accept it.
Pa! Well said!
Is it all over? That's great.
That's wonderful!
Now no more demons will come make trouble.
Xiaoyu's like she woke from a long dream. She remembers nothing of late.
It feels like I had a dream, but I can't recall it. Yet deep in my memory, there seems to be someone I just can't forget. Who could he be?
He's...
Pingyan!
Oh...

Miss Xiaoyu! Let this humble Taoist give you some advice. Deep in everyone's memory are one or two people they can never forget. But sometimes keeping those memories locked away is beautiful too. Don't force that window open, all right?
Mm... I understand! Thank you, old man~
You can skip the "old man" part!
Pa! That was beautiful! If I hadn't heard it myself, I'd never have believed it, not in a million years.
Pa?
I regret it so much! Why did I turn down the money? Waaah......
Pa!
Oh right! Yin Wen and Xiaojun are coming over. I'll head home first.
Okay! Be careful on the way. I'll be back a bit later.
Okay, I'm off.
Ha ha ha~ Thousands of years of searching, and at last I've found it!
Hmm... Better visit the Longlai Hotel first.
This spiderweb is huge... Looks like we need to get a big pair of scissors!
I've got to find some big scissors first~
Pingyan~ Hurry, cut the web with the big scissors~
Watch this... Snip~ snip~ snip~

These little spiders are tough! You can't kill them, and they won't get out of the way. But no worries, here are four cans of our company's new product. One little spray and they drop dead~ It's still a prototype, though, so each can is single-use!
The latest disposable VF Bug Spray. Single use only! Psst, I stashed quite a few in the treasure chests in this cave!
Pssht~ pssht~ pssht~
Got VF Bug Spray!
Better gather some information first!
I should go back to the manager first.
20 silver for the night.
How can I help you?
20 silver for the night.
The heavens show strange omens, and three General Stars have risen. I have a bad feeling...
Master! Legend says the General Stars appearing is a sign of great chaos. Is it true?
It is! Not just the human realm... the immortal and demon realms may be swept into this disaster.
The immortal and demon realms! Then our great task of the Investiture...
Pa... don't die... Yin Wen, Xiaojun, where are you... Ugh... Wh-where am I?
Young Highness, you're awake! This is Xiqi, city of Ji Chang, Lord of the West. You've been out for three days...
Out for three days? Wait! Where's Shen Gongbao?
I wouldn't know, sir. Please ask His Majesty! He awaits you in the main hall!
His Majesty awaits you in the main hall!
This is the city of Xiqi.
You're His Majesty's new young Highness! So handsome.
Heh heh... You've got good taste!
His Majesty has another young Highness too, but he looks so scary!
You mean that Beakface guy!
Beakface? That's so mean! Tee hee hee...
Young Highness, are you awake?
His Majesty is waiting for you.
His Majesty is holding court in the main hall.
His Majesty is holding court in the main hall.
Welcome back safely, Your Majesty, and with two new princes! Truly blessed by Heaven.
Take care on your way!
Still, now that His Majesty fled Zhaoge, what will King Zhou do?
Take care on your way!
Huh! Beanpole, you're awake! You sure are lucky. I thought you'd never wake up!
Sorry to disappoint you, Beakface!
Got a death wish? Maybe I'll make sure you never wake up.
Oh yeah? If you want to be a roast birdie, I'd be happy to help.
What?
Pingyan, my son, are you all right now? That's wonderful!
Don't call me "Pingyan, my son." It's awkward. Just call me Pingyan! And how about this: I won't call you Father either. From now on I'll call you Pa!
Ha ha ha~ Interesting! Have it your way!
Thanks, Pa!
Oh, Pingyan~ Now you can tell me properly where you come from! I couldn't follow you before, but now we have time.
It's a long story~ Listen carefully...
So, got all that?
I didn't really follow, but basically you're not from this world. And you need to find your two friends, Yin Wen and Ji Xiaojun, and return to your world together. Is that it...
So, Pa, I hear you're a master of divination. Do you know any way I can get back to my world?
Sadly~ I'm not sure. But never mind! Stay with me and enjoy every luxury. No need to go back at all.
I think there's one person who'd know...
Seriously? Beakface!
Suddenly I've forgotten...
Big bro! Please be the bigger man. That was my fault!
Leizhenzi, my son, just tell him!

For Father's sake, I'll let it slide, Beanpole. It's my master's friend, Ancient South. He knows all things in heaven and on earth. But he lives on treacherous Qilin Cliff, where demons roam. Way too dangerous for a weakling like Beanpole...
I'm going no matter what!
I can't stop you, I see. Your second brother Ji Fa is skilled in letters and arms. He'll go with you!
W-we? I have to go too? Well, if Father commands it, fine!
Thank you, Father!
Summon Prince Ji Fa.
Father, you sent for me?
Escort your two brothers to Qilin Cliff to see Ancient South!
Yes, Father!
Take care, all of you!
Setting out, young Highness?
Safe travels, young Highness!
Safe travels, young Highness!
Setting out, young Highness?
Are you feeling all right now?
All three princes are so handsome!
With demons running rampant out there, only Xiqi is fairly safe.
This is the city of Xiqi.
Poor man~ King Zhou held the Lord of the West captive in Youli for seven years.
They say to save himself, Ji Chang even ate meat patties made from his own eldest son.
Ji Chang's eldest, Bo Yikao, offended King Zhou's consort Daji... and was killed and made into patties.
This is the Shang dynasty. The Son of Heaven is King Zhou.
There are four great lords: Ji Chang of the West, Jiang Huanchu of the East, E Chongyu of the South and Chong Houhu of the North. Pillars of Zhaoge.
Ever since Daji came, King Zhou has been a changed man.
King Zhou's advisor, Grand Tutor Wen, studied magic with the demon sages of Jin'ao Island.
Do you believe there are immortals in this world?
What insight! Here's a secret: there are immortals AND demon sages. Immortals live on Mount Kunlun, led by Yuanshi Tianzun. Demon sages live on Jin'ao Island, led by Tongtian.
Is that so? What a shame!
Want to know about summon beasts?
Is that so? Never mind, then.
In unknown corners of this world, mighty summon beasts lie hidden. They say they appear in times of chaos. Their inborn power is essential in battle. Be sure to find the summon beasts!
Why won't Amei marry me?
What lovely weather!
Whoa~ It's Beakface!!
Well said!
Shut it, you little brat!
Whoa~ Beakface is mad!
Ah! You must be the young Highness!
After Bo Yikao died, Ji Fa became the heir.
Qilin Cliff lies north of Xiqi.
There are lots of demons and monsters out there~ Gear up before you leave town!
Hmph! I'm not marrying Acai! I'd end up "Auntie Acai." That sounds awful~ No way!
Brothers, this is a long journey. Put safety first and don't overreach...
Relax, big bro~ We're not that lame!
Yeah! Big bro~ You worry too much!
True enough, but brothers~ Father may dote on you, but there's an order to seniority. You should address me as Second Brother! "Big bro" is far too disrespectful...
Second Brother is fine! But by seniority, shouldn't you call us Brother No. 100 and Brother No. 101?
Ah! Why didn't I think of that! From now on you're Brother No. 100 and Brother No. 101!
..........Hey, Beakface~ If we don't want to lose any more brain cells, let's quit joking around with our dead-serious Second Brother...
Agreed.........
This is the Investiture List. I entrust this heavy duty to you...
Yes, Master~ Even if it shatters me to pieces, I will fulfill the Investiture!
Then take care on your journey.
Then your disciple departs the mountain.
Halt! Jiang Shang, you old fool! Hand over the Investiture List!
Th-the Investiture List! Shen Gongbao, how do you know about it?
Enough talk! Have at you!
Stop, Shen Gongbao! Why harm your fellow disciple? He bears the Investiture! Crane Boy! Seize him!
Yes, sir!
You? Please...
Ha ha~
Y-you're not Shen Gongbao! Who are you?
Heh heh heh... I am indeed Shen Gongbao. Just not the Shen Gongbao you know.
Jiang Shang, flee! I'll hold him off...
Can you?
Huh? Sage! What happened to you...
Beakface, don't just stand there! Save him or the old geezer's gonna croak...
N-no good! It's not working at all!
Your power stinks, Beakface! Let me try!
Huh? It's not working for me either? How can that be?
You're no better! And you called me lame!
Quit bickering! At this rate the old sage will croak... I mean, pass on...
I-is that... Leizhenzi? I've been struck... by Shen Gongbao's Cosmic Palm... Go get your... master, Yunzhongzi. You can't... save me...
Yes! We'll go right away! My master's cave is on Mount Zhongnan, not far from here.
Then let's hurry!
Ah!
Bro~ You trying to scare me to death?!
Is it all right to just leave Ancient South lying there?
Ancient South is an immortal. He'll be fine! Besides, if we go back now, the old geezer... I mean, the old sage is a goner!
I guess so...?
Huff... huff... So tired... Finally here...
Huh? What's this miasma-looking thing? Anyone care to explain?

S-sorry, Beanpole~ I forgot. Master set up a barrier to keep busybodies from disturbing his training. We have to go to the Dragon God Cave first and get the Dragon God Pearl to break it... Otherwise even I, his star pupil, can't get in~
Y-you idiot Beakface! Why didn't you say so sooner? This is your own home!
Beanpole! Are you done? It's because you kept rushing me the whole way that I got flustered...
There's a seal here!
Heh heh heh... Oh, Beakface~ So now it's my fault...
Hurry to the Dragon God Cave!
Enough, enough! Stop fighting! If we're going to the Dragon God Cave, let's hurry!
Hmph!
Hmph!
Welcome to De'an Village!
They say Sister Daji in Zhaoge is so pretty! Xiaofang wants to be pretty like her~
When I grow up I'll join the army and protect Xiaofang forever...
I hear Lord Ji Chang was imprisoned seven years. How did he endure it...
From De'an Village: Mount Zhongnan is east, Dragon God Cave north, Trial Cave west~
Legend says a Dragon God in the cave guards the Dragon God Pearl...
I hear a summon beast, the Fox-Marten, lives in the Trial Cave to the west.
Got the Fox-Marten!
Lord Dragon God, it's been a long time!
Ah, Leizhenzi! What brings you here?
Ah, Leizhenzi!
Ancient South is badly hurt and I must see Master. But he hates outside meddling, so he sealed Mount Zhongnan with a barrier. May I borrow the Dragon God Pearl to break it?
I see. But the Dragon God Pearl is this cave's guardian treasure. Still, you're no outsider... Tell you what! It's been so long, let me see if you've improved! Defeat me and I'll lend you the pearl.
Then please, teach me a lesson!
Not good enough~ Train some more!
Ha ha ha~ Well done! Well done! You really haven't been slacking these years.
Of course! Master is very strict!
Take the Dragon God Pearl! But once your business is done, return it right away~
Don't worry!
Rare to see Beakface so polite.
Shut it, Beanpole~ What do you know? Lord Dragon God was always kind to me as a kid. I respect him...
No time for story hour. Let's go! Next stop, Mount Zhongnan!
Wait for me, Beanpole!
Return the pearl once your business is done!
There, the seal is broken. Let's go.
Leizhenzi, you're back!
So jealous~ I want to go down the mountain too.
Jealous of what? First thing I did down the mountain was meet this beanpole. Given the choice, I'd have stayed...
Are you done, Beakface?!
B-Beakface!? Tee hee hee......
Don't call me that here!
Yes, Beakface~
Tee hee hee~
Master is at the altar!
Someday I want to go down the mountain too.
You're back, Leizhenzi. Is your father, the Lord of the West, well?
Yes! Thanks to you, Master, Father made it safely back to Xiqi...
Is that so? Wonderful. But you hurried back so fast. Did something happen?

Ancient South was struck by Shen Gongbao's Cosmic Palm!? Shen Gongbao, an immortal of Kunlun, dared such treachery? This is grave. The Cosmic Palm is an evil art long lost to the world. As a Kunlun disciple, Shen Gongbao couldn't possibly know it! As far as I know, nothing but Dragon Sinew and Phoenix Bone can revive Ancient South now...
Where do we find Dragon Sinew and Phoenix Bone?
I'm not sure. They're legendary immortal treasures. You'd best ask the Dragon God! As chief of the dragons, he may know something!
I was just about to return the pearl to the Dragon God!
Let's hurry!
Hurry and find the Dragon Sinew and Phoenix Bone!
How long do you plan to hold out? Hand it over!
Even if you kill me, I'll never hand it over!
Sh-Shen Gongbao!
Heh heh! Brat, we meet again! I'll finish you off first!
L-let go of me!
Leizhenzi! Get out of here, and live on! Farewell...
Lord Dragon God! What are you saying?!
Let's get out of here! The cave is about to collapse...
B-but...
If we stall and die here, how could we face the Dragon God? Snap out of it, Beakface!
Hurry! It's really coming down!
We have to get out of the Dragon God Cave, fast!
L-Lord Dragon God...
Let's go, Beakface. You look awful when you cry!
What would a beanpole like you know?! Can you understand how I feel right now?
Of course I do!
What!
Shen Gongbao killed my Pa right in front of me... How could I not understand? Crying won't help! If it could bring Pa back, I'd cry myself to death!
